## About Benjamin Lau

Benjamin is an accomplished technology leader with over a decade of experience specializing in architecting and scaling engineering teams to deliver nation-wide digital transformation projects and mission-critical Singapore Government systems.

### Professional Experience

#### Partner at EMQ2 (Dec 2022 - Present)
Location: Singapore
Website: https://emq2.io/

- Led the strategic vision and decision-making for a portfolio of highly-sensitive digital transformation projects, valued at over SGD 1 million, impacting millions of stakeholders, including public servants and the general public.
- Orchestrated the development and implementation of Gateway and Platform-based systems facilitating secure and seamless transactions related to User Authentication through Singapore's National Digital Identity Initiatives and Payment Systems.
- Played a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability and trustworthiness of systems supporting millions of daily transactions, maintaining a 99.9% uptime and delivering uninterrupted services to government agencies and citizens.
- Pioneered the establishment of robust systems and processes, playing a pivotal role in achieving ISO 27001 Certification for Information Security Management Systems.

#### Technical Manager at Zionext (2020 - 2022)
Location: Singapore & Chennai (India)
Website: https://zionext.com/

- Successfully managed and led a team of Technical Leads across the company as a key member of the Management Team with Company Directors.
- Developed and implemented training strategies that enhanced the technical capabilities of employees.
- Actively nurtured and mentored new Technical and Functional Leads, fostering a company culture that values risk-taking, promotes innovation and ownership.

#### Technical Lead of Operations & Support at Kydon (2019 - 2020)
Location: Singapore & Malaysia
Website: https://kydonlsg.com/

- Expertly managed a team of over 30 Software Engineers, overseeing an extended portfolio of more than 30 active projects spanning the public and private sectors.
- Coordinated closely with key stakeholders including DevOps Engineers, Product Owners, Project Managers, Business Analysts and Quality Assurance Specialists.

#### Software Development Engineer at MQ Spectrum (2015 - 2019)
Location: Singapore
Website: https://mqspectrum.com

- Led a team of over 10 Software Engineers, managing day-to-day operations on multiple high-value projects.
- Spearheaded new initiatives to build sustainable Software Engineering Teams by implementing Agile development methodologies and adopting the SCRUM framework with CI/CD pipelines.

## Certifications

### Enterprise Design Thinking Co-Creator
Issuer: IBM
Description: An active contributor on Enterprise Design Thinking engagements, bringing real-world user outcomes to life by growing collaboration skills and finding opportunities to step up and lead.

### Google Professional Workspace Administrator
Issuer: Google Cloud
Description: Proficiently handle administrative tasks within the G Suite admin console, provide guidance on optimal organizational structure, user and service management, effectively monitor security events and risks, implement measures to safeguard users and organizational data.

### Technical Assessment for Solution Architect
Issuer: The Digital Academy, GovTech Singapore
Description: Formally certified and passed the Technical Assessment for Solution Architect by GovTech Singapore, specialized for working on government projects.

### AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate
Issuer: Amazon Web Services
Description: Certified to build secure and robust solutions that are scalable, resilient, efficient, and fault-tolerant using AWS Well-Architected Framework.

### Agile with Atlassian Jira
Issuer: Atlassian
Description: Acquired a solid understanding of agile methodologies, and gained the ability to proficiently create and manage agile boards in Jira Software Cloud.

### Certified ScrumMaster
Issuer: NCIF & Scrum Alliance
Description: Led software development team in adopting Scrum values, driving productivity, fostering collaboration, and delivering projects effectively.
